The nacos client addresses are FQDNs: nacos-0.nacos-headless.train-ticket.svc.cluster.local:8848 — the nacos gRPC client needs DNS resolution too. Since the pod's dnsPolicy is None with a nameserver 10.255.1.254 that times out, both istiod lookup AND nacos lookup fail. So the root mechanism is DNS resolution failure in the pod.
